title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. I born in India live in london since 45 years. I visit my birth place to see my relatives.what type of Namaz I have to pray from the day one qasr or full? What type of namaz I will have to offer if I travel under 48 miles from next day of my arrival to my watan? you can ignore my question Id 3179 which asked yesterday. 2842 views Q. Dear Sheikh! Can we pray Ishraq Salah at home? 6402 views Q. I work in Saudi Arabia and go back home after every one year. I belong to Nainital district of U.P. (Now Uttarakhand) which is very near to Bareilly and the Barelwi Maslak is rampant in that area. "Mazar parasti" and Urs, etc., are the foremost part of their Islam and Aqeeda. In my village there are only two mosques and the Imams leading the prayers are staunch Barelwi. I had a discussion with one of these Imams of our moque, he has the belief that to ask for help (Mannat) with the dead (Mazar) is as good as praying God. Since then, I stopped praying with him. I offer all my five prayers in my home during my vacation of one month or so. Secondly, my wife is very punctual in prayers and other Shariah matters. She also joins my prayers which I lead in my house. Please enlighten me on;(1)if, under the circumstances explained above, my prayers in my home are correct, (2) prayers led by me and joined by my wife are correct. or I should go the mosque and pray behing the same Imam as explained above. I shall highly appreciate your immediate reply on the above e-mail address. Best regards 2929 views Q. Salaam If an imaam makes mistakes such as 'sits down in the fourth rakaat' when he should stand who is corrected by the people behind him, who then say subhanallah and this occurs with the imaam 2/3 times a week, 1/ should the imaam be replaced? 2/ would the salaat have to be performed again? 1742 views Q. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 166518 Country: India Title: Dear Sheikh! Can we pray Ishraq Salah at home? Question: Dear Sheikh! Can we pray Ishraq Salah at home? Answer ID: 166518 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 284/219/B=03/1440) Yes, you may offer. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
